name: CIS Critical Security Controls
description: Safeguards in Controls 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 12, 13, 16 and 18 that Paddock evidences or supports.

controls.title: Maintain a detailed enterprise asset inventory
controls.summary: Keep an accurate, detailed and current inventory of enterprise assets.
controls.rationale: Discovered external assets plus passively observed internal devices.

controls.title: Address unauthorized assets
controls.summary: Have a process to handle unauthorized assets.
controls.rationale: New assets surface as changes for review; the removal/quarantine process is organisational.

controls.title: Utilize an active discovery tool
controls.summary: Use an active discovery tool to identify assets, run on a schedule.
controls.rationale: Scheduled, scope-checked active probing of authorised targets.

controls.title: Use a passive asset discovery tool
controls.summary: Use a passive discovery tool to identify assets and update the inventory.
controls.rationale: Sentry identifies devices from mirrored traffic without sending a packet.

controls.title: Maintain a software inventory
controls.summary: Keep a detailed inventory of licensed and open-source software.
controls.rationale: The SBOM covers analysed code projects; installed commercial software on endpoints is covered only where fleet agents report packages.

controls.title: Ensure authorized software is currently supported
controls.summary: Only currently supported software is in the inventory as authorized.
controls.rationale: Vulnerable and outdated components are flagged; end-of-life status is not tracked for every package.

controls.title: Utilize automated software inventory tools
controls.summary: Use software inventory tools to automate discovery and documentation of installed software.
controls.rationale: SBOMs are generated automatically from lockfiles.

controls.title: Encrypt sensitive data in transit
controls.summary: Encrypt sensitive data in transit using TLS or similar.
controls.rationale: Observed endpoints and segments only.

controls.title: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process
controls.summary: Maintain a secure configuration process for enterprise assets and software.
controls.rationale: Paddock verifies outcomes (headers, TLS, policies); the configuration process itself is organisational.

controls.title: Uninstall or disable unnecessary services
controls.summary: Disable unnecessary services such as unused file sharing or web modules.
controls.rationale: Unnecessary public exposure is detected and tracked to closure.

controls.title: Establish and maintain a vulnerability management process
controls.summary: Maintain a documented vulnerability management process.
controls.rationale: The operating process is evidenced by Paddock; the written process document is organisational.

controls.title: Establish and maintain a remediation process
controls.summary: Maintain a risk-based remediation strategy with periodic review.
controls.rationale: Owner routing and SLA policies per severity, measured continuously.

controls.title: Automated vulnerability scans of internal assets
controls.summary: Scan internal assets at least quarterly, authenticated and unauthenticated.
controls.rationale: Passive and agent-based visibility only; not an authenticated internal scanner.

controls.title: Automated vulnerability scans of externally exposed assets
controls.summary: Scan externally exposed assets at least monthly.
controls.rationale: Continuous external scanning; status passes when a scan completed in the last month.

controls.title: Remediate detected vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Remediate detected vulnerabilities at least monthly, based on the remediation process.
controls.rationale: Measured from detection to verified fix.

controls.title: Collect audit logs
controls.summary: Collect audit logs and ensure logging is enabled across enterprise assets.
controls.rationale: Paddock's own operations only.

controls.title: Establish and maintain a secure network architecture
controls.summary: Design networks with segmentation, least privilege and availability in mind.
controls.rationale: Observed segmentation and its violations; the architecture design is organisational.

controls.title: Establish and maintain architecture diagram(s)
controls.summary: Maintain architecture diagrams and other network system documentation.
controls.rationale: The observed map and asset graph support, but are not, maintained architecture documentation.

controls.title: Deploy a network intrusion detection solution
controls.summary: Deploy network intrusion detection where appropriate.
controls.rationale: Passive behaviour analytics for IoT/OT; not a signature-based NIDS.

controls.title: Collect network traffic flow logs
controls.summary: Collect and review network traffic flow logs and/or traffic for alerts.
controls.rationale: Sentry ships flow summaries from mirrored segments; coverage is limited to mirrored ports.

controls.title: Inventory of third-party software components
controls.summary: Maintain an inventory of third-party components used in development, with risk evaluation.
controls.rationale: SBOM with continuous OSV matching.

controls.title: Implement code-level security checks
controls.summary: Use static and dynamic analysis tools in the development life cycle.
controls.rationale: Static taint analysis only; no DAST in the build pipeline.

controls.title: Establish and maintain a penetration testing program
controls.summary: Maintain a penetration testing program appropriate to the enterprise.
controls.rationale: Paddock does not perform penetration testing.
controls.attestation: Provide the penetration testing program and reports.
